content.text: The data shows Zone_F3_Z01's temperature rising from ~24.4 °C (June) to ~25.1 °C (Oct-Nov) while peer zones (F3_Z02, F3_Z03, F3_Z05, F4_Z0x) actually decrease. This divergence is consistent with either a real local load increase or a sensor drift, but the available streams (zone air temperature sensors + heating/cooling setpoints only — no CO2, occupancy, VAV airflow/supply air temp, outside air, or a redundant sensor in the same zone) cannot distinguish the two causes.
